Name: Fishing Life
Author: Yadm
Description:
[size=4][b]Fishing Life[/b][/size]

The fishing bar stays closed. Your rod and your fishing level decide whether the fish stays on the line.
[line]
The fish on the line is still the fish the game chose. The chance starts at the rod's floor and rises in a straight line to the rod's ceiling at level 10. The day's luck moves that chance by about 2 points either way. Each luck level from food adds 1 point. Food and the Master enchantment count toward the fishing level. A level past 10 counts as 10.

[heading]More from Yadm[/heading]


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54022]Hired Help[/url]. Hire a neighbor, pay them, and they walk the farm and do the chores. Choose from 12 neighbors and more than 50 jobs: water, hoe, plant, harvest, the greenhouse, animals, kegs, jars, casks, furnaces, forage, trees, and hay.


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53092]Guild Kill List[/url]. After floor 100 of the Mines, the monster eradication list is on your inventory.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url]. Inventory and chest buttons from other mods share one column.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53287]Perfection Shortcut[/url]. After Qi's Walnut Room unlocks, an inventory button opens the game's perfection tracker.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53144]Staircase Spacing[/url]. A staircase stays in your bag when another ladder is already nearby in the Mines or Skull Cavern.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54345]Sprinklers All Day[/url]. A sprinkler fires every two hours when a dry tilled tile is in reach. The 6:00 AM watering stays the game's.


[heading]The catch[/heading]


A training rod counts as level 5 until you are higher, so it starts at 75% and reaches 90% at level 10. A bamboo pole starts at 60% and reaches 85%. A fiberglass rod starts at 65% and reaches 95%. An iridium rod and an advanced iridium rod start at 75% and reach 100%. An iridium rod at level 10 always catches the fish. A bamboo pole, fiberglass rod, or training rod can still miss at level 10.


A rod from another mod uses the iridium ceiling when it has a tackle slot, and the fiberglass ceiling when it only has a bait slot.


Each 10 points of fish difficulty takes one point off the chance. Cork, trap, barbed hook, lead, and deluxe bait still add the help they gave the bar. When this bite also has a chest, Treasure Hunter adds 10 points. A rod that is not certain stops at 95% after that.


[heading]A miss[/heading]


A miss leaves the fish and the chest in the water. The game already used the bait on the bite. Tackle still wears out on a miss.


[heading]Perfect catch[/heading]


A landed fish then rolls a perfect catch. That chance is 40% of the catch chance, and it stops at 45%. An iridium rod at level 10 is a 40% perfect catch. Treasure Hunter adds 15 points when this bite also has a chest, and the total still stops at 45%. The game's own perfect rule then raises quality and experience. The training rod still keeps the fish at minimum size and normal quality. A perfect catch shows Perfect above you.


[heading]What stays the game's[/heading]


Treasure chests stay on the game's own chance. The loot stays the game's. Golden chests stay the game's mastery roll.


Trash, algae, and seaweed come in without a roll. During a festival, the real bar stays, so the Stardew Valley Fair and the Festival of Ice still score the minigame. Crab pots are unchanged.


Which fish bites, how fast it bites, a second fish from wild bait, a challenge bait stack, quality bobbers, and the Preserving enchantment stay on the game's own code.


[heading]The lower-left line[/heading]


The lower-left line shows the fish's icon and names the fish, and it says whether it was caught or got away, with the chance.


[heading]Options[/heading]


Enabled starts on. One switch turns the skip off, and the bar comes back.


[list]
[*]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], open Fishing Life and uncheck Skip the fishing bar. The next bite uses the bar.[/*]
[*]Or, after the first launch, edit Mods/FishingLife/config.json and set "Enabled": false.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional. It adds the in-game checkbox.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Installation[/heading]

[list]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this download into Stardew Valley/Mods, or install the zip with Vortex.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
The mod folder should look like this:

[code]
Mods/FishingLife/
FishingLife.dll
manifest.json
README.md
i18n/default.json[/code]

config.json appears after the first launch.


[heading]Uninstall[/heading]


Remove the FishingLife folder from Stardew Valley/Mods, or remove it in Vortex.


[heading]Compatibility[/heading]


English only. There is no language picker in the mod.


One switch turns the skip off. The bar comes back.
